sloka: न विनश्येत्कथं कार्यं रामस्य विदितात्मनः ।एकामेकश्च पश्येयं रहिते जनकात्मजाम् ॥५-२-३८॥
transliteration: na vinaśyetkathaṁ kāryaṁ rāmasya viditātmanaḥ ।ekāmekaśca paśyeyaṁ rahite janakātmajām ॥5-2-38॥

translations.english: 'How can the purpose of Rama, a noble soul be not spoilt? I may have a private audience with the daughter of Janaka.
